title: Read an entity’s source history
responsibility: Reads up to 100 Git commits affecting a unit’s owned source paths at the requested revision.

inputs.name: catalogHistory.root
inputs.description: The repository root passed to gitRead for the Git history query. It has no effect when the unit has no owned source paths and no documentation path.

inputs.name: catalogHistory.revision
inputs.description: The Git revision argument passed unchanged to git log when the unit has source or documentation paths. It is not validated or used when that combined path list is empty.

inputs.name: catalogHistory.unit
inputs.description: The ComponentManifest whose owns.source paths, followed by documentation when present, define which files are queried. If both contribute no paths, the function resolves to an empty array without calling gitRead.

examples.title: Read an entity’s source history
examples.responsibility: Reads up to 100 Git commits affecting a unit’s owned source paths at the requested revision.

outputs.name: catalogHistory
outputs.type: Promise<{ id: string; at: string; kind: "commit"; title: string; detail: string; commit: string; version: null; }[]>
outputs.description: A promise resolving to at most 100 Git commits for the supplied revision, filtered to unit.owns.source and unit.documentation when present. Each entry contains the commit hash as id and commit, the author date and subject, kind “commit”, the fixed source-change detail, and version null; no paths or no matching commits yields an empty array.

examples.title: Refine catalog history service
examples.detail: Source changed. Verification is recorded separately.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A rejected gitRead call propagates when the Git history command fails. The function skips the Git read when the manifest has no source or documentation paths.
